[ASSISTANT_SAID] To create and export a report in Kibana, open Kibana and navigate to the dashboard or visualization you want to include in your report.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Click on the "Share" button in the top right corner of the screen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Choose "Generate PDF" from the dropdown menu.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In the "PDF Reports" dialog box, select the report format, orientation, and page size that you want to use. You can also customize the report title and add a description.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Choose whether to include a cover page, a table of contents, and other optional elements in the report.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Click the "Generate" button to generate the report.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Once the report is generated, you can preview it by clicking on the "Download" button in the dialog box. You can also choose to save the report to your computer, send it via email, or print it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The "Generate PDF" feature is available in the Kibana UI only for Kibana 7.1 and later.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For earlier versions of Kibana, you can use third-party plugins or the Reporting API to generate reports.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kibana also supports the creation of CSV reports, which can be exported from Kibana's Discover UI.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To create a CSV report, open Kibana and navigate to the Discover UI, run your search query, click on the "Download" button, choose the "CSV" format, and click the "Download" button to download the report.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Setting up machine learning in Kibana involves installing and configuring the Elastic Stack, preparing your data, configuring machine learning settings, training your models, evaluating and refining your models, and deploying your models.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To install and configure the Elastic Stack, download and install Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Beats, and configure them to work together.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Data for machine learning should be well-structured and organized in Elasticsearch, and you need to identify the features or attributes for your models.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In Kibana, configure machine learning settings by selecting the Machine Learning tab and specifying algorithms, maximum anomalies to detect, and time ranges for training and testing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Train your models by selecting the data and specifying features or attributes, using Kibana's tools to create machine learning jobs.
